    #pragma once
    
    #include <cstdint>
    
    namespace rex::input::mnk {
    
    // GTA IV stores an action's logical magnitude as the XOR of a per-action
    // polarity byte and its current encoded byte. Negative and positive halves of
    // an axis consequently use different encoded bytes for the same magnitude.
    constexpr uint8_t DecodeActionMagnitude(uint8_t polarity,
                                            uint8_t encoded_value) noexcept {
      return static_cast<uint8_t>(polarity ^ encoded_value);
    }
    
    constexpr uint8_t EncodeActionMagnitude(uint8_t polarity,
                                            uint8_t magnitude) noexcept {
      return static_cast<uint8_t>(polarity ^ magnitude);
    }
    
    constexpr uint8_t MergeActionMagnitude(uint8_t polarity,
                                           uint8_t encoded_value,
                                           uint8_t requested_magnitude) noexcept {
      const uint8_t current_magnitude =
          DecodeActionMagnitude(polarity, encoded_value);
      return requested_magnitude > current_magnitude
                 ? EncodeActionMagnitude(polarity, requested_magnitude)
                 : encoded_value;
    }
    
    }  // namespace rex::input::mnk

    #include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>
    
    #include <rex/input/mnk/encoded_action.h>
    
    namespace {
    
    using rex::input::mnk::DecodeActionMagnitude;
    using rex::input::mnk::EncodeActionMagnitude;
    using rex::input::mnk::MergeActionMagnitude;
    
    TEST_CASE("action magnitude encoding preserves both polarities",
              "[input][encoded_action]") {
      for (const uint8_t polarity : {uint8_t{0}, uint8_t{255}}) {
        for (const uint8_t magnitude :
             {uint8_t{0}, uint8_t{1}, uint8_t{127}, uint8_t{255}}) {
          CHECK(DecodeActionMagnitude(
                    polarity, EncodeActionMagnitude(polarity, magnitude)) ==
                magnitude);
        }
      }
    }
    
    TEST_CASE("action merge compares decoded magnitudes",
              "[input][encoded_action]") {
      CHECK(MergeActionMagnitude(0, 0, 255) == 255);
      CHECK(MergeActionMagnitude(255, 255, 255) == 0);
    
      const uint8_t positive_existing = EncodeActionMagnitude(0, 200);
      const uint8_t negative_existing = EncodeActionMagnitude(255, 200);
      CHECK(MergeActionMagnitude(0, positive_existing, 100) == positive_existing);
      CHECK(MergeActionMagnitude(255, negative_existing, 100) ==
            negative_existing);
      CHECK(DecodeActionMagnitude(
                255, MergeActionMagnitude(255, negative_existing, 250)) == 250);
    }
    
    }  // namespace

Plan

Fix native-resolution post-FX transient views
Summary
The execution trace identifies three invalid post-FX resolves in one gameplay frame: the half-resolution, intermediate luminance, and small luminance sources are resolved without having been rendered during that frame. Each immediately follows a valid write to a compatible surface with twice its dimensions. The final composite then crushes the frame to black; presentation only carries that result forward. Evidence is in [Liberty Recompiled_398.1.log (line 9696)](/tmp/liberty-run398-live.EY31k6/Liberty Recompiled_398.1.log:9696).
The generated game code deliberately creates alternating downsample surfaces and resolves them as part of the stock post-FX chain, as shown in [gta4_recomp.13.cpp (line 48005)](/Users/Ozordi/Downloads/LibertyRecomp/glue/rexglue-sdk-main/gta4-recomp/generated/gta4_recomp.13.cpp:48005). The new native-resolution path exposes the guest’s transient-view reuse assumption because each guest surface handle currently owns an isolated Vulkan image.
The fix will emulate that transient-view behavior narrowly inside composite post-FX. It will not modify HDR, shaders, reflection rendering, guest hooks, or globally alias surfaces by address.
Implementation changes
Add internal surface-write lineage in [graphics_system.h (line 319)](/Users/Ozordi/Downloads/LibertyRecomp/glue/rexglue-sdk-main/src/graphics/gta4_native/graphics_system.h:319):
Per-surface last write frame, monotonic write serial, placement address, command index, and render phase.
Renderer-level record of the most recent successful color-surface write in the current frame.
Record writes from implicit attachment clears, successful explicit clears, successful draws with an effective color-write mask, and renderer materialization operations.
Keep ever_written for attachment initialization only; do not use it as proof that the surface contains current-frame content.

Before a normal resolve in RenderPhase::kCompositePostFx, materialize an unwritten transient view only when all deterministic conditions hold:
The source has no write stamp from the current frame.
The immediately preceding successful color write is from the same frame and a different surface.
Both are non-reflection color images with the same Vulkan format and sample count.
Both are single-sampled and blit-capable.
The source logical extent equals the existing CalculatePostFxExtent half-resolution result for the predecessor in both axes.
No global address search is performed. Placement addresses remain diagnostic because the first failing pair uses different encoded placement values, while later pairs use equal values.

Materialize the complete predecessor image into the source surface:
Transition the predecessor to transfer-source and the transient view to transfer-destination.
Perform a full-extent scaled Vulkan blit.
Use linear filtering when supported and nearest filtering as the deterministic capability fallback.
Restore the predecessor’s prior layout and leave the source in a layout the existing resolve path can transition from.
Mark the source current-frame-written, then execute the existing resolve unchanged.
Never hard-code surface handles, shader hashes, resolutions, or command indices.

Add deterministic causal records:
point=postfx-transient-view-materialized with frame, command, source/predecessor handles, placement values, extents, format, write serial, and filter.
point=postfx-transient-view-rejected with the exact failed predicate.
Preserve the existing unwritten-resolve and final-composite probes so the repair can be verified from one joined log.

No public title-command, guest-memory, shader-override, or configuration interface changes.

Tests and acceptance
Add unit coverage to the existing unit_tests target for:
Valid current-frame half-resolution predecessor selection.
Odd-dimension extent handling.
Rejection of stale-frame, non-composite, reflection, format, sample-count, and dimension mismatches.
Rejection when the source was already written in the current frame.

    #!/usr/bin/env python3
    import collections
    import glob
    import re
    
    LOG_GLOB = (
        "/Users/Ozordi/Downloads/LibertyRecomp/out/build/macos-release/"
        "LibertyRecomp/Liberty Recompiled.app/Contents/MacOS/logs/"
        "Liberty Recompiled_555*.log"
    )
    
    draw_pattern = re.compile(
        r"frame=(?P<frame>\d+).*?cmd=(?P<cmd>\d+).*?point=draw-state.*?"
        r"vs=[^: ]+:(?P<vs>[0-9A-F]+).*?ps=[^: ]+:(?P<ps>[0-9A-F]+).*?"
        r"textures=(?P<requested>\d+):(?P<bound>\d+):\[(?P<textures>.*?)\].*?"
        r"blend=(?P<blend>[^ ]+) alpha=(?P<enable>\d+):(?P<function>\d+):"
        r"(?P<reference>[^ ]+)"
    )
    
    texture_pattern = re.compile(
        r"(?P<slot>\d+):(?P<handle>[0-9A-F]+)@(?P<generation>\d+):"
        r"(?P<hash>[0-9A-F]+):f(?P<format>\d+):(?P<width>\d+)x"
        r"(?P<height>\d+):m(?P<first_mip>\d+)-(?P<last_mip>\d+)"
    )
    
    shader_counts = collections.Counter()
    state_counts = collections.Counter()
    texture_counts = collections.Counter()
    examples = collections.defaultdict(list)
    
    for path in glob.glob(LOG_GLOB):
        with open(path, "r", errors="replace") as stream:
            for line in stream:
                match = draw_pattern.search(line)
                if not match or match.group("enable") != "1":
                    continue
                shader_key = (match.group("vs"), match.group("ps"))
                state_key = (match.group("function"), match.group("reference"))
                shader_counts[shader_key] += 1
                state_counts[state_key] += 1
                if len(examples[shader_key]) < 3:
                    examples[shader_key].append(
                        (match.group("frame"), match.group("cmd"), match.group("textures"))
                    )
                for texture in texture_pattern.finditer(match.group("textures")):
                    texture_counts[
                        (
                            shader_key,
                            texture.group("slot"),
                            texture.group("format"),
                            texture.group("width"),
                            texture.group("height"),
                            texture.group("first_mip"),
                            texture.group("last_mip"),
                            texture.group("hash"),
                        )
                    ] += 1
    
    print("alpha draw states")
    for key, count in state_counts.most_common():
        print(count, key)
    
    print("alpha shader pairs")
    for shader_key, count in shader_counts.most_common(30):
        print(count, shader_key, examples[shader_key])
        top_textures = [
            (texture_key, texture_count)
            for texture_key, texture_count in texture_counts.items()
            if texture_key[0] == shader_key
        ]
        top_textures.sort(key=lambda item: item[1], reverse=True)
        for texture_key, texture_count in top_textures[:8]:
            print("  ", texture_count, texture_key[1:])

    #!/usr/bin/env python3
    
    import argparse
    import re
    import shutil
    import subprocess
    from pathlib import Path
    
    
    ENTRY_RE = re.compile(
        r'\{\s*(0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+),\s*((?:[0-9]+,\s*)+)"([^"]+)"\s*\}'
    )
    
    
    def main() -> None:
        parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
        parser.add_argument("cache", type=Path)
        parser.add_argument("hash", type=lambda value: int(value, 0))
        parser.add_argument("output", type=Path)
        args = parser.parse_args()
    
        source = args.cache.read_text()
        selected = None
        for match in ENTRY_RE.finditer(source):
            values = [int(match.group(1), 16)]
            values.extend(int(value) for value in match.group(2).split(",") if value.strip())
            if values[0] == args.hash:
                selected = (values, match.group(3))
                break
        assert selected is not None, f"shader 0x{args.hash:X} not found"
        values, filename = selected
        assert len(values) == 10, values
    
        compressed_match = re.search(
            r"g_compressedSpirvCache\[\] = \{([^}]*)\};", source, re.DOTALL
        )
        assert compressed_match is not None
        compressed = bytes(
            int(value) for value in compressed_match.group(1).split(",") if value.strip()
        )
        args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        compressed_path = args.output / "spirv.zst"
        blob_path = args.output / "spirv.bin"
        compressed_path.write_bytes(compressed)
        zstd = shutil.which("zstd")
        assert zstd is not None
        subprocess.run(
            [zstd, "-d", "-f", str(compressed_path), "-o", str(blob_path)],
            check=True,
        )
        blob = blob_path.read_bytes()
        _, _, _, base_offset, base_size, late_offset, late_size, _, _, mask = values
        assert base_offset + base_size <= len(blob)
        (args.output / "base.smolv").write_bytes(blob[base_offset:base_offset + base_size])
        if late_size:
            assert late_offset + late_size <= len(blob)
            (args.output / "late.smolv").write_bytes(blob[late_offset:late_offset + late_size])
        print(f"filename={filename}")
        print(f"mask=0x{mask:X}")
        print(f"base_offset={base_offset} base_size={base_size}")
        print(f"late_offset={late_offset} late_size={late_size}")
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        main()

    #!/usr/bin/env python3
    
    PIXELS_PER_BC1_BLOCK = 4 * 4
    BITS_PER_SELECTOR = 2
    SELECTOR_MASK = (1 << BITS_PER_SELECTOR) - 1
    
    
    def alpha_counts(color0: int, color1: int, selectors: int) -> tuple[int, int]:
        transparent = 0
        opaque = 0
        for pixel in range(PIXELS_PER_BC1_BLOCK):
            selector = (selectors >> (pixel * BITS_PER_SELECTOR)) & SELECTOR_MASK
            is_transparent = color0 <= color1 and selector == SELECTOR_MASK
            transparent += int(is_transparent)
            opaque += int(not is_transparent)
        return transparent, opaque
    
    
    assert alpha_counts(0x0000, 0xFFFF, 0xFFFFFFFF) == (16, 0)
    assert alpha_counts(0xFFFF, 0x0000, 0xFFFFFFFF) == (0, 16)
    assert alpha_counts(0x0000, 0xFFFF, 0x00000000) == (0, 16)
    assert alpha_counts(0x0000, 0xFFFF, 0xE4E4E4E4) == (4, 12)
    
    print(f"pixels_per_block={PIXELS_PER_BC1_BLOCK}")
    print(f"bits_per_selector={BITS_PER_SELECTOR}")
    print(f"selector_mask={SELECTOR_MASK}")

    #!/usr/bin/env python3
    import glob
    import re
    from collections import defaultdict
    
    LOG_GLOB = (
        "/Users/Ozordi/Downloads/LibertyRecomp/out/build/macos-release/"
        "LibertyRecomp/Liberty Recompiled.app/Contents/MacOS/logs/"
        "Liberty Recompiled_556*.log"
    )
    
    query_pattern = re.compile(
        r"point=translucent-query-result frame=(\d+) cmd=(\d+) .*?"
        r"category=([^ ]+) variant=([^ ]+) shader=([^ ]+) .*?"
        r"samples-passed=(\d+) available=(\d+) recorded=([^ ]+)"
    )
    content_pattern = re.compile(
        r"point=translucent-content-probe frame=(\d+) cmd=(\d+) .*?"
        r"category=([^ ]+) role=([^ ]+) .*?texture-stage=(\d+) .*?"
        r"alpha=samples:(\d+),zero:(\d+),intermediate:(\d+),one:(\d+),nonfinite:(\d+)"
    )
    
    pairs = defaultdict(dict)
    content = []
    for path in glob.glob(LOG_GLOB):
        with open(path, "r", errors="replace") as stream:
            for line in stream:
                match = query_pattern.search(line)
                if match:
                    frame, command, category, variant, shader, samples, available, recorded = (
                        match.groups()
                    )
                    key = (int(frame), int(command), category, shader)
                    pairs[key][variant] = {
                        "samples": int(samples),
                        "available": int(available),
                        "recorded": recorded,
                    }
                match = content_pattern.search(line)
                if match:
                    content.append(match.groups())
    
    summary = defaultdict(lambda: {"pairs": 0, "alpha": 0, "raster": 0})
    for key, variants in pairs.items():
        if "alpha-on-raster" not in variants or "raster-only" not in variants:
            continue
        frame, command, category, shader = key
        alpha_samples = variants["alpha-on-raster"]["samples"]
        raster_samples = variants["raster-only"]["samples"]
        row = summary[(category, shader)]
        row["pairs"] += 1
        row["alpha"] += alpha_samples
        row["raster"] += raster_samples
        ratio = alpha_samples / raster_samples if raster_samples else None
        ratio_text = "n/a" if ratio is None else f"{ratio:.6f}"
        print(
            f"PAIR frame={frame} cmd={command} category={category} "
            f"shader={shader} alpha={alpha_samples} raster={raster_samples} "
            f"ratio={ratio_text}"
        )
    
    print("SUMMARY")
    for (category, shader), row in sorted(summary.items()):
        ratio = row["alpha"] / row["raster"] if row["raster"] else None
        ratio_text = "n/a" if ratio is None else f"{ratio:.6f}"
        print(
            f"category={category} shader={shader} pairs={row['pairs']} "
            f"alpha={row['alpha']} raster={row['raster']} ratio={ratio_text}"
        )
    
    print("CONTENT")
    for fields in content:
        print(" ".join(fields))

    #!/usr/bin/env python3
    
    PIXELS_PER_BLOCK = 4 * 4
    BITS_PER_SELECTOR = 3
    SELECTOR_MASK = (1 << BITS_PER_SELECTOR) - 1
    SELECTOR_BYTES = (PIXELS_PER_BLOCK * BITS_PER_SELECTOR) // 8
    
    assert PIXELS_PER_BLOCK == 16
    assert BITS_PER_SELECTOR == 3
    assert SELECTOR_MASK == 7
    assert SELECTOR_BYTES == 6
    
    
    def palette(alpha0: int, alpha1: int) -> list[float]:
        values = [alpha0 / 255.0, alpha1 / 255.0]
        if alpha0 > alpha1:
            for index in range(1, 7):
                values.append(((7 - index) * values[0] + index * values[1]) / 7.0)
        else:
            for index in range(1, 5):
                values.append(((5 - index) * values[0] + index * values[1]) / 5.0)
            values.extend([0.0, 1.0])
        return values
    
    
    assert palette(0, 255)[6:] == [0.0, 1.0]
    assert len(palette(255, 0)) == 8
    print(
        f"pixels_per_block={PIXELS_PER_BLOCK} "
        f"bits_per_selector={BITS_PER_SELECTOR} "
        f"selector_mask={SELECTOR_MASK} selector_bytes={SELECTOR_BYTES}"
    )

    Add: /tmp/analyze_alpha_to_coverage_run.py
    #!/usr/bin/env python3
    
    import glob
    import re
    import sys
    
    
    paths = sorted(glob.glob(sys.argv[1]))
    card_re = re.compile(
        r"point=translucent-query-result frame=(\d+) cmd=(\d+) draw=([0-9A-F]+) "
        r"category=(tree-card|grass-card|cutout-card) variant=(alpha-on-raster|raster-only) "
        r".*?samples-passed=(\d+).*?alpha=.*?to-mask=(\d+)"
    )
    state_re = re.compile(
        r"point=(?:draw-state|alpha-card-state).*?category=(tree-card|grass-card|cutout-card).*?to-mask=1"
    )
    errors = ("VUID-", "Validation Error", "device lost", "Device lost")
    pairs = {}
    states = []
    found_errors = []
    for path in paths:
        with open(path, "r", errors="replace") as source:
            for line_number, line in enumerate(source, 1):
                match = card_re.search(line)
                if match:
                    frame, command, draw, category, variant, passed, to_mask = match.groups()
                    key = (frame, command, draw, category)
                    pairs.setdefault(key, {})[variant] = (int(passed), int(to_mask), path, line_number)
                if state_re.search(line):
                    states.append((path, line_number, line.rstrip()))
                if any(token in line for token in errors):
                    found_errors.append((path, line_number, line.rstrip()))
    
    complete = [(key, value) for key, value in pairs.items() if len(value) == 2]
    reduced = []
    for key, value in complete:
        alpha = value["alpha-on-raster"][0]
        raster = value["raster-only"][0]
        if alpha < raster:
            reduced.append((key, alpha, raster, value["alpha-on-raster"][2],
                            value["alpha-on-raster"][3]))
    
    print(f"files={len(paths)} to_mask_states={len(states)} complete_pairs={len(complete)} "
          f"coverage_reduced_pairs={len(reduced)} errors={len(found_errors)}")
    for item in states[-5:]:
        print(f"STATE {item[0]}:{item[1]} {item[2]}")
    for key, alpha, raster, path, line_number in reduced[-10:]:
        print(f"REDUCED frame={key[0]} cmd={key[1]} draw={key[2]} category={key[3]} "
              f"alpha={alpha} raster={raster} at={path}:{line_number}")
    for item in found_errors[-10:]:
        print(f"ERROR {item[0]}:{item[1]} {item[2]}")

- Preserved the correct early fragment shader.

    import hashlib
    import pathlib
    import re
    import subprocess
    
    
    SOURCE = pathlib.Path("LibertyRecompLib/shader/shader_cache.cpp")
    TEXT = SOURCE.read_text()
    
    
    def entry(shader_hash: str):
        pattern = re.compile(
            rf"\{{ 0x{shader_hash}, 0, 0, (\d+), (\d+), (\d+), (\d+),"
        )
        match = pattern.search(TEXT)
        if not match:
            raise RuntimeError(f"missing cache entry {shader_hash}")
        return tuple(int(value) for value in match.groups())
    
    
    array_match = re.search(
        r"const uint8_t g_compressedSpirvCache\[\] = \{([^}]*)\};", TEXT
    )
    if not array_match:
        raise RuntimeError("missing compressed SPIR-V cache")
    compressed = bytes(int(value) for value in array_match.group(1).split(",") if value)
    compressed_path = pathlib.Path("/tmp/liberty_spirv_cache.zst")
    decoded_path = pathlib.Path("/tmp/liberty_spirv_cache.bin")
    compressed_path.write_bytes(compressed)
    subprocess.run(
        ["/opt/homebrew/bin/zstd", "-d", "-f", str(compressed_path), "-o", str(decoded_path)],
        check=True,
    )
    decoded = decoded_path.read_bytes()
    
    for shader_hash in ("C3256D6D7C2E426D", "C64FD3C169FB7A5A"):
        early_offset, early_size, late_offset, late_size = entry(shader_hash)
        early = decoded[early_offset : early_offset + early_size]
        late = decoded[late_offset : late_offset + late_size]
        print(
            shader_hash,
            "early",
            early_offset,
            early_size,
            hashlib.sha256(early).hexdigest(),
            "late",
            late_offset,
            late_size,
            hashlib.sha256(late).hexdigest(),
        )
    
    left = entry("C3256D6D7C2E426D")
    right = entry("C64FD3C169FB7A5A")
    for variant, pair in (
        ("early", (left[:2], right[:2])),
        ("late", (left[2:], right[2:])),
    ):
        (left_offset, left_size), (right_offset, right_size) = pair
        left_blob = decoded[left_offset : left_offset + left_size]
        right_blob = decoded[right_offset : right_offset + right_size]
        print(variant, "identical", left_blob == right_blob)
